idea-plugin.name: AskSage
idea-plugin.description:
AskSage integrates the AskSage.ai API directly into your JetBrains IDE, providing conversational AI assistance with user-selectable internet access modes and dynamic model selection across all major AI providers.

Key Features

  • Live Mode Toggle — Switch between No Live (offline), Live (web search), and Live+ (deep research) modes
  • Model Selection — Choose from all available AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.), dynamically fetched from AskSage
  • Chat Interface — Streaming responses with markdown rendering, multi-turn conversation history, and follow-up suggestions
  • Prompt Templates — Built-in templates for Code Review, Security Audit, Performance Analysis, Unit Test Generation, Architecture Review, and more
  • Editor Integration — Right-click context menu: Explain Code, Refactor, Generate Docs, Ask About File, Send Selection (with keyboard shortcuts)
  • Plugin Browser — Browse and execute AskSage plugins with results rendered inline
  • Knowledge Base Training — Add code from the editor directly to your AskSage datasets
  • Token Usage — View monthly token usage for the current application
  • Multi-Project Awareness — Automatic project language detection for contextual queries
  • Conversation Export — Export conversations as Markdown or JSON with timestamps
  • Secure Authentication — API key stored securely via IntelliJ PasswordSafe with automatic token exchange

Getting Started

  1. Install the plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace
  2. Go to Settings > Tools > AskSage
  3. Enter your AskSage API email and API key
  4. Open the AskSage tool window (right sidebar) and start chatting

Data & Privacy

This plugin sends the prompts you type and any code you explicitly choose to share (editor selections, files sent via context actions, and knowledge-base uploads) to the Ask Sage service for processing by the AI model you select. No code is transmitted without an explicit user action. Use of the service is governed by the Ask Sage Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. A paid Ask Sage account and API key are required.

This plugin is a community-provided integration published by BigBear.ai LLC and is not produced by Ask Sage, Inc. The Ask Sage wordmark is used with authorization.
